name: Hy-Memory-30B-A3B: Attributed Reinforcement Learning for Long-Term Memory Writing (arXiv:2610.22196)
notes: Abstract fetched 2026-10-16. Submitted 15 Oct 2026 (v1). Describes Hy-Memory-30B-A3B as a compact long-term-memory writer trained across Mem0, MemOS, and Hy-Memory with Memory On-Policy Distillation then Memory RL (chunk-level GRPO). Reports the same 55.49% macro average versus 54.62% for Claude Opus 5 on fixed 20% benchmark subsamples, including held-out EverMemOS. Architecture numbers used in the model record come from the HF config.json, not from this abstract; the paper is cited for the training method and the benchmark claim.
